column1: # results/CORPUS-EXCLUSIONS.tsv -- rows of results/all_runs.csv that are NOT what their CSV cell key says they are.
# Created at CORRECTIONS 230 (cycle 152).  Machine-readable; read it with analysis/corpus_exclusions.py.
# WHY: results/all_runs.csv has no column for a harness INTERVENTION that the ARGS line cannot carry.
# `cvt1` (CORRECTIONS 227) ran PATCH_VOTEWEIGHT with VOTE_W=<tensor>:<w>, which reweights one tensor's term
# inside the shared meta-gradient sum.  VOTE_W rides only the run's own `VOTE_W:` witness line, so
# aggregate.py (unedited) writes MUTE and DOSE rows with k01's cell key (granularity `scalar`) and INJECT
# rows with HEAD's cell key.  They are NOT plain scalar / plain HEAD measurements.
# RULE FOR EVERY CORPUS READER THAT POOLS BY CELL (noise floors, cell means, anchors, O2 re-derivations):
# drop every row whose (run, job_id) is listed here BEFORE grouping.  analysis/corpus_exclusions.py
# provides load() / is_excluded(row) / filter_rows(rows), and `--check` verifies this file against the CSV
# and the raw .out witness lines.  A new intervention batch whose design the ARGS line cannot carry
# appends its rows here in the same commit as its ingest.
# The plain arms of the same batch (cvt1-k01-*, cvt1-HEAD-*) print `VOTE_W: off` and are NOT listed:
# they are ordinary measurements of their cells.
# columns: run, job_id, batch, arm, looks_like (the plain arm whose cell key the row carries), intervention,
#          witness (the run's own VOTE_W line, verbatim), registered_at, reason
